shared_elements: horizontal band of incised linear pattern near the top of the form
justification: The only correspondence is the most generic one: both surfaces carry a shallow horizontal band of incised lines encircling the upper part of a rounded three-dimensional form, a device any tradition might produce. A is densely covered with a specific figural programme (a headed anthropomorphic form with arms, a prominent concentric disc, curved bands and small motifs across the back), whereas B bears no figural or symbolic imagery at all beyond the faint rim band.
